description: Shows one of `loading`, `empty`, `error` or `success` for a data source. Set `source` to derive the state from the named data source: loading and error from its status, empty when its value is null, an empty list or an empty map. An explicit `status` or `isEmpty` overrides what `source` derives. The subtree reads the source as `data.<source>`.

props.name: status
props.description: Loading, error or ready; overrides the status derived from `source`.

props.name: isEmpty
props.description: The source has no content; shows the `empty` slot while ready. Overrides the emptiness derived from `source`.

props.name: source
props.description: The data source of the page or plugin whose loading, error and empty states the widget shows.

slots.name: success
slots.description: Shown when the source is ready and not empty.
